name: dingtalk-calendar-sync
description: Two-way sync between DingTalk Calendar and Google Calendar, Calendly-ready: DingTalk events appear in a dedicated Google calendar, and Google events (Calendly bookings by default) appear in DingTalk

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Choose a password of **at least 8 characters**. You'll enter it to open the dtsync setup page, and it encrypts the credentials you save there. 请设置至少 8 个字符的密码：打开设置页面时需要输入，它也用于加密你保存的登录凭证。
